parameters.query:
UPDATE "Lead" 
SET 
  enriched_profile = $1::jsonb,
  conversation_context = $2,
  recommended_approach = $3,
  enrichment_status = $4,
  enriched_at = NOW(),
  lead_score = $5,
  decision_power = $6,
  detected_city = $7,
  detected_company = $8,
  linkedin_url = $9
WHERE id = $10
